boundary_evidence: WHOLE UNIT. This TU licenses 0x020d1018..0x020d5a54, 28 functions, ROM ordinals 0..27, as one .text claim. build/tu_map.json reports 0x020d1018..0x020d5974, 26 functions, and puts dScMgAmida_c_classInit (0x020d5974, 0xdc) and func_ov006_020d5a50 (0x020d5a50, 4 bytes) in a separate class-less run: its right boundary stops at the last MANGLED member (AfterCleanupResources). The relocation census below proves both internal, so the unit is 28 functions. LOW EDGE: the previous run ends with func_ov006_020d100c at 0x020d1018. HIGH EDGE: _ZN14dScMgBomroom_cD1Ev at 0x020d5a54 starts dScMgBomroom_c's unit.

RELOCATION CENSUS, the method. Every relocation in config/arm9/**/relocs.txt was indexed and each referring WORD was resolved back to its containing function through that module's own symbols.txt, so referrers self-identify by NAME rather than by module tag. Two filter traps were measured on this image and both are real. (1) Keying on the exact tag module:overlay(6) returns 6,981 relocations, while asking whether 6 is IN the target module SET returns 7,104: the exact-tag filter silently drops 123 relocations spelled across 16 ambiguous module sets, among them overlays(2,6), overlays(5,6), overlays(6,90) and overlays(6,9,14,15,16,18,20,21,22,26,27,29,36). (2) The module set on its own does not discriminate at all here, because every ov006 minigame leaf answers to the same set; only the resolved referrer NAME separates them.

POSITIVE CONTROL, PASSED. The census returns _ZTV12dScMgAmida_c (0x0213b918) at the exact slot offsets the class header declares: InitResources at +0x00 (slot 0), AfterCleanupResources at +0x14 (slot 5), Behavior at +0x18 (slot 6), Render at +0x24 (slot 9), D1 at +0x40 (slot 16), D0 at +0x44 (slot 17), OnYoshiTryEat at +0x48 (slot 18), and the slot 31/34/35/36 overrides at +0x7c/+0x88/+0x8c/+0x90. Every vtable-pinned member comes back with the class's own _ZTV at the offset it is declared at. The vtable ADDRESS itself has exactly three referrers image-wide: D1 (from 0x020d10a0), D0 (from 0x020d1150) and dScMgAmida_c_classInit (from 0x020d5a2c); the third is what puts classInit in this run.

BASE-RATE CONTROL over two sibling ov006 classes, same census, comparable window widths. The census DISCRIMINATES; it is not returning the same set for everything. This run [0x020d1018,0x020d5a54) resolves to 6 dScMgAmida_c members, dScMgAmida_c_classInit, 12 words of its own vtable and 4 unlabelled ov006 helpers that are themselves inside the run, with ZERO dScMgTrampoline_c and ZERO dScMgBomroom_c referrers. The dScMgBomroom_c run immediately above [0x020d5a54,0x020d9574) resolves to 4 dScMgBomroom_c members, 39 words of its own vtable and 19 of its own helpers, ZERO Amida. The dScMgTrampoline_c / dScMgTrampoline2_c run immediately below [0x020d01e0,0x020d1018) resolves to 8 dScMgTrampoline_c and 6 dScMgTrampoline2_c members, both of their classInits and __sinit_ov006_0212fc7c, ZERO Amida.

THE TWO BOUNDARY WORDS, INDIVIDUALLY. LOW EDGE: the function immediately below the run, func_ov006_020d1008 (0x020d1008, 4 bytes), is referenced by _ZN17dScMgTrampoline_cD0Ev, _ZN17dScMgTrampoline_cD1Ev, _ZN18dScMgTrampoline2_cD0Ev, _ZN18dScMgTrampoline2_cD1Ev, both Trampoline classInits and __sinit_ov006_0212fc7c: it is the Trampolines' array destructor, not Amida's. The first word of the run, _ZN12dScMgAmida_cD1Ev (0x020d1018), is referenced only by Amida's own vtable. HIGH EDGE: func_ov006_020d5a50 has exactly ONE referrer image-wide, dScMgAmida_c_classInit, which hands it to __cxa_vec_ctor as the per-element constructor for the 0x80-entry piece array; the next function above it, _ZN14dScMgBomroom_cD1Ev (0x020d5a54), is referenced only by _ZTV14dScMgBomroom_c. Each of the run's other unlabelled func_ov006_* helpers likewise has every one of its referrers inside the run.

VTABLE SLOTS 0 AND 3: THE ABSTRACT HYPOTHESIS IS REFUTED ON THIS CLASS, and is recorded here as a refutation. Read out of extracted/overlays/overlay_0006.bin, slot 0 at 0x0213b918 is 0x020d5384 and slot 3 at 0x0213b924 is 0x02043bf0. Neither is a bare zero word and both carry a relocation: slot 0 a load to 0x020d5384 in module overlay(6), the class's own InitResources, and slot 3 a load to 0x02043bf0 in module main, an inherited override. dScMgAmida_c is not abstract at 0 or at 3, so an abstract slot is NOT the mechanism behind tu_map's undercount here. The undercount is at the TOP edge only, and its mechanism is that tu_map's right boundary stops at the last mangled member.

VTABLE LENGTH: 37 pointer slots (0..36), terminating at 0x0213b9ac where the next word reads 0x00000100 and is not a code address. The 31-words=dActor_c / 32-words=dBgActor_c rule DOES NOT APPLY to this class and was not used: dScMgAmida_c is a dScMgBase_c leaf, not an actor. Measured control in the same overlay: _ZTV14dScMgBomroom_c 36 slots, _ZTV11dScMgCard_c 37, _ZTV11dScMgCoin_c 36, _ZTV16dMgJump3DMario_c 8, _ZTV12dMgCardObj_c 3. The minigame-scene family sits at 36-37 and the 31/32 test does not separate its members.

WIDENED from the earlier 13-function claim 0x020d3624..0x020d5a54. The function that split the run, func_ov006_020d27dc (ordinal 14, 0x020d27dc, 0xe48), was a NONMATCHING draft; it byte-matched in its own file first (commit 'Match func_ov006_020d27dc'), and with it the run is one piece. 15 one-function files were folded: D1, D0, func_ov006_020d116c, Virtual8C, Unk36, Virtual7C, func_ov006_020d122c, func_ov006_020d1450, Virtual88, func_ov006_020d1958, func_ov006_020d1a3c, func_ov006_020d1ba0, func_ov006_020d2580, func_ov006_020d25fc and func_ov006_020d27dc.

KEY FUNCTION. The out-of-line ~dScMgAmida_c() is the class's first declared virtual, so this TU now emits _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS12dScMgAmida_c and the ancestor RTTI chain (fBase_c, dBase_c, dScene_c, dScMgBase_c). Each is a deadstrip-data row with its canonical symbols.txt home; ov006 .data stays ROM-owned, so the TU stays text-only. dScMgAmida_c_classInit now stores the vptr as &_ZTV12dScMgAmida_c[2], the emitting-TU spelling, instead of &data_ov006_0213b918.

DESTRUCTOR ORDER. The cartridge has D1 at 0x020d1018 (0xa0) below D0 at 0x020d10b8 (0xb4) and no D2 for this class anywhere in the image: D1 ends exactly where D0 begins, and D0 ends exactly at func_ov006_020d116c. One out-of-line ~dScMgAmida_c() under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1 then D0 in that order; the D2 mwccarm also emits, and the 4-byte vague-linkage D1 of dScMgAmida_c::Point, are compiler_only_output deadstrip rows. No relocation in the object references either.

EMISSION ORDER. Source order is ROM-ASCENDING under #pragma defer_codegen off; tubuild verify reports all 28 functions in the expected ROM-ascending section order. Optimisation pragmas are positional push/off/pop brackets: opt_strength_reduction off on func_ov006_020d122c, func_ov006_020d27dc, func_ov006_020d3ba0, func_ov006_020d452c, func_ov006_020d47f4, Render and Behavior; opt_common_subs off on func_ov006_020d25fc, func_ov006_020d27dc, func_ov006_020d452c, func_ov006_020d47f4 and Render.

notes: Assembled by hand: first from the thirteen one-function sources above the old hole (tubuild.py create refuses shards that wrap their bodies in an extern "C" block), then widened by hand over the fifteen below it. See the file's own header comment.

Declaration reconciliation, all of it codegen-free and all of it settled by the 13/13 byte match rather than by argument. Where two shards spelled one interface differently the more complete observation was kept and the narrower call site took the implicit conversion. func_02054efc returns void* per include/decl_common.h and three shards had re-declared it as char*, so those call sites now cast. _ZN11dScMgBase_cC2Ev returns void per decl_common.h and classInit had declared it int, whose result it discarded. data_ov006_0213b918 is a scalar in decl_common.h and classInit had declared it an int array, so its address is now taken with &. MultiStore16 takes void*, so the char* call site converts implicitly. data_ov006_0212e1a8 is char[], which both shards then do byte arithmetic on. func_ov006_020d36a4 keeps its own definition's dScMgAmida_c* parameter and its two callers pass this and a cast pointer. func_ov006_020d3668's definition took NO parameter while its one call site passes the scene pointer; under C linkage only one prototype can exist, so it now declares an unnamed, unread void* parameter.

Declaration reconciliation for the widen, all of it checked by the 28/28 byte match. One extern "C" declaration per symbol at file scope; where a shard had spelled a parameter differently, the call casts. func_ov006_020d3624 now declares an unnamed, unread void* parameter, because func_ov006_020d1450 and the pen handler pass the scene. func_ov006_020d2580 takes the two rung ends as by-value dScMgAmida_c::Point, the form the pen handler declared; its old C definition read them through int pointers, which is the same calling convention. LoadCompressedFileAt is declared (int, void *): Virtual7C passes a word from data_ov006_0213b838 without truncating it, and a u16 parameter adds two words there. data_020a0e40 is a scalar and data_020a0dea/deb are u8[][4]: func_ov006_020d1958 needs the row form (flat indexing costs it four words), and func_ov006_020d1a3c and func_ov006_020d1ba0 compile identically either way. func_02012718 uses the (int, int) declaration in include/decl_common.h; func_ov006_020d27dc's (void *) casts on its first argument are gone with no byte change.

Every slot-36 call in the unit goes through dScMgAmida_c::Unk36(). Four of the folded shards (func_ov006_020d122c, func_ov006_020d1958, func_ov006_020d1a3c, func_ov006_020d27dc) called it through a local 37-slot stand-in struct; the bytes are unchanged.
